# x402 Multi-Tool API

> Pay-per-request data toolkit for AI agents. 13 no-auth tools, $0.0050 USDC each, settled over the x402 micropayment protocol on Base (network base). No API key or signup — an agent wallet pays per call.

## How to call

Each tool is an HTTP POST endpoint. An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with an x402 payment challenge (the `accepts` array names the asset, amount and payTo address); resend with the `X-PAYMENT` header to receive the JSON result. Payments go to 0x7aEDE9Bb3A0c28132643ED8e416e4728f03FC18f as USDC on Base.

## Tools

- [web_search](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/serp): Search the web and return organic results as structured JSON. (required: query)
- [read_url](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/read): Fetch a web page and return its cleaned main text as JSON. (required: url)
- [crypto_price](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/price): Live crypto USD price + 24h change by CoinGecko id. (required: ids)
- [wikipedia_summary](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/wiki): Wikipedia lead extract, description and URL for an article title. (required: title)
- [news_headlines](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/news): Fresh news articles (title, source, link, date) for a query. (required: query)
- [current_weather](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/weather): Current weather by place name: temperature, humidity, wind, conditions. (required: location)
- [fx_rates](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/fx): Foreign-exchange rates from a base currency to all or selected currencies.
- [ip_geolocation](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/geoip): Map an IP address to city, country, coordinates, org and timezone. (required: ip)
- [dns_lookup](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/dns): Resolve a domain's A/AAAA/MX/TXT/NS/CNAME records over DNS-over-HTTPS. (required: name)
- [trending_crypto](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/trending): Top trending coins right now by CoinGecko search volume.
- [stock_quote](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/stock): Live stock quote: price, previous close, day change and market state for a ticker. (required: symbol)
- [domain_whois](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/domain): Domain WHOIS/RDAP: registrar, registration & expiry dates, status, nameservers. (required: domain)
- [crypto_markets](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/api/markets): Top coins by market cap with price, rank and 24h change.

## Discovery

- [x402 manifest](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/.well-known/x402): machine-readable service list with bazaar schemas.
- [MCP manifest](https://x402deploy.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp.json): Model Context Protocol tool catalog.
